native_mechanisms: SIMD/simultaneous equality sweep over both sequences marks every matching position at once (the doubled shadow), giving the no-gap score without touching any DP cell
Cost of the stretch between two matches is computed arithmetically from how far each sequence must advance (index/prefix arithmetic), never by filling or walking intermediate cells
Over alignments allowing exactly one slip (one gap run), keep only the cheapest running tally at each match — spent-slip or unspent — and discard every costlier one immediately
core_technique: Exact banded Needleman-Wunsch (two rows, AVX2 prefix-max/Hillis-Steele gap scan) whose band width is derived from lower bounds — SIMD Hamming score plus an O(n) one-gap probe — with a self-certifying narrow pass; the banded DP, not the native scheme, produces the returned score.
